await page.evaluate('async () => {\n  const rows = [];\n  for (let p = 1; p <= 10; p++) {\n    const html = await (await fetch(\'?page=\' + p)).text();\n    const doc = new DOMParser().parseFromString(html, \'text/html\');\n    doc.querySelectorAll(\'table tr\').forEach(tr => {\n      const c = [...tr.querySelectorAll(\'td\')].map(td => td.textContent.trim());\n      if (c.length) rows.push(c);\n    });\n  }\n  const m = rows.filter(r => r[1] === \'Northwind\' && r[3] === \'overdue\');\n  const odd = rows.filter(r => /northwind/i.test(r[1]) && r[1] !== \'Northwind\' || /overdue/i.test(r[3]) && r[3] !== \'overdue\');\n  const cents = m.reduce((s, r) => s + Math.round(parseFloat(r[2].replace(/[$,]/g, \'\')) * 100), 0);\n  const ids = rows.map(r=>r[0]);\n  return { n: rows.length, uniq: new Set(ids).size, m, total: cents / 100, odd };\n}');
```
